dossier.valuation_method: Probability-weighted sum-of-the-parts / rNPV at ~13% cost of equity, built from explicit per-asset cash-flow schedules: on-market LGSOC franchise NPV gated by RAMP 301 confirmatory survival (~60%), plus PoS-weighted rNPV of VS-7375 (KRAS-G12D, bottom-up ex-China peak ~$2.25B x 22%) and RAMP 205 (PDAC), net of cash burn and below-NAV financing leakage; integrated across discrete company-level scenarios (composite headline $7.16; expected-value SOTP cross-check $7.72)
dossier.thesis_summary: Verastem owns the first and only FDA-approved therapy for KRAS-mutant recurrent LGSOC (avutometinib+defactinib, ~$75M annualized run-rate), but the approval is accelerated and conditional on the RAMP 301 confirmatory Phase 3 (~60% survival, readout ~2028). Value is a probability-weighted, schedule-derived sum-of-the-parts at ~13% cost of equity: the on-market orphan franchise (conditional NPV ~$1.0B, NPV/peak ~1.6x) plus a differentiated-but-early KRAS-G12D asset (VS-7375, ~$320M rNPV) and a high-risk PDAC combination (~$68M), netted for heavy cash burn and serial below-NAV dilution. Integrating the full outcome distribution yields a fair value of $7.16 (floor $3.25 on the franchise alone), with a wide, right-skewed band reflecting a ~40% withdrawal tail against meaningful pipeline upside.
key_value_drivers: RAMP 301 confirmatory PFS outcome (~60% franchise survival) — the master switch
LGSOC commercial trajectory: re-acceleration of new-patient starts and duration-on-therapy (Q1'26 decelerated to +6.5% seq)
VS-7375 KRAS-G12D development success and bottom-up ex-China peak (~$2.25B success case, ~22% PoS)
Dilution trajectory: ~130-145M shares likely by the 2027 readout; below-NAV leakage
key_risks: RAMP 301 fails -> accelerated approval withdrawn ~2028, removing the entire revenue base
Commercial plateau if the healthy addressable pool is shallower than the funnel implies
Serial below-NAV equity dilution; sales miss could lock out Oberland debt tranches
VS-7375 is early, partnered (ex-China only), mid-pack vs Revolution Medicines (pan-RAS Ph3) and Astellas
Gross-margin compression from Chugai/Pfizer/Oberland royalty stack; Chugai EU/Japan opt-back caps ex-US upside
what_would_change_my_mind: RAMP 301 positive (or strong interim) -> franchise de-risked, FMV toward $13-18
Re-acceleration of new-patient starts + disclosed long duration-on-therapy
Mature VS-7375 PFS/OS confirming best-in-class durability
A non-dilutive ex-US or VS-7375 partnership breaking the dilution cycle
Conversely: RAMP 301 negative, continued commercial stall, or a large discounted raise -> toward the $3.25 floor

gaps: Per-asset net-cash margins (LGSOC ~44%, VS-7375 ~37%, RAMP 205 ~33%) are stated rather than built from full per-indication P&Ls including the explicit royalty-stack waterfall — reasonable for rNPV, but a fully-built operating model per asset would be the last increment of rigor.
The VS-7375 funnel incidence figures are sound estimates but are not individually source-cited; adding citations would make the bottom-up build fully auditable by a third party.
